scripts.changes:check: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$base" ] || [ "$base" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]; then base=HEAD~1; fi; node scripts/krn.mjs changes check --root . --base "$base" --head HEAD --before
scripts.changes:push: base=${KRN_PUSH_BASE:-$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)}; [ "$base" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ] && base=''; resolved=$(git rev-parse --verify "${base:-HEAD}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -z "$base" ] || [ -z "$resolved" ] || [ "$resolved" = "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" ]; then base="$(git rev-parse HEAD~1 2>/dev/null)"; fi; if [ -z "$base" ]; then echo 'changes:push: no base range (root commit)' >&2; base="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; fi; node scripts/krn.mjs changes check --root . --base "$base" --head HEAD --before
